 Hello Chris, 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 It’s cold this morning here in Quebec City! -37°C (-35°F).

 So it's quite weird to announce the Lasclay "end-of-winter" sale . 😅

 But we'll stick to our calendar, since we traditionally launch this sale toward the end of January, when the dust settles after November and December. And wow—what a season it’s been!

 Two massive months, by far the biggest in the history of our young company: 

 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 We are incredibly proud of this and see it as a sign that milkweed is beginning to break through on a larger scale. But now that the dust has settled, we are turning our focus back to our mission and looking ahead, at a time when the clock is ticking more than ever for monarch butterflies.

 We are not straying from our vision: to develop, as quickly as possible, real markets for milkweed crops, one of the last strongholds for the survival of monarch butterflies threatened with extinction. 

 This mission quite literally keeps us up at night, and we’ve been fortunate to be surrounded by an army of passionate people who have believed in it with us from the very beginning. Lasclay (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KFR2MA2KC8DN2F31APXHZF84_0) is a community. A community that has supported us since day one, trusted us, and given us the courage to build this ambitious company, dedicated to this extraordinary plant that is milkweed and to all the wildlife that depends on it.

 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Every Lasclay product sold is a boost for the incredibly resilient milkweed growers, who have weathered the ups and downs of this very young industry since 2013. Every product that leaves our workshop is another step toward preserving, and even expanding milkweed fields, helping ensure a sustainable future for monarch butterflies.

 If you’d like to support our mission and stay warm for the rest of this winter and the seasons to come, we’re excited to announce our end-of-season sale , starting now , with limited stock reserved for our newsletter subscribers.

 After being nearly sold out in November and December, we’ve restocked almost all products which, as always, are expected to sell out very, very quickly.

 We’re offering a simple progressive discount for this sale, increasing with the number of items in your cart:

 2 items: 10% off your order 
 3–4 items: 15% off 
 5 items: 20% off 

 All Lasclay products are eligible. For a few days only, we’re also offering FREE SHIPPING on all orders. 

 Don't wait too long - our accountant won’t be happy and might shut this down! 😅 

 To take advantage of our end-of-season sale, just click the button below 👇 

 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Shop the Lasclay end-of-season sale (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KFR2MA2KC8DN2F31APXHZF84_1)
 

 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Have a great month of February 😉 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Warmly,

 Gabriel
